Title: Boulder City Council Special Meeting and Study Session - August 10, 2023

Topic1.Title: Boards and Commission Appointments Public Hearing
Topic1.Summary: Council held a public hearing on 2023 midterm board and commission appointments. Staff presented vacancies for the Environmental Advisory Board, Landmarks Board, Open Space Board of Trustees, and University Hill Commercial Area Management Commission. A speaker who had signed up was not present. Council nominated and voted on candidates using a finalist process, appointing Hannah Davis, Greg Hill, Renee Golbeck, Harmon Zuckerman, and Tell Jones, and then approved the appointments unanimously.

Topic2.Title: University Hill Commercial Area Revitalization
Topic2.Summary: Community Vitality staff presented strategies to revitalize the University Hill commercial district, including its General Improvement District funding limits, regulatory constraints on liquor hours and food sales, high vacancy rates, and safety concerns. Staff recommended prioritizing broad district-wide strategies such as district identity, connectivity, and activation before redeveloping the 14th Street surface parking lot. Council generally supported the approach and asked staff to explore code changes, including the liquor hours and 50 percent food sales rules.

Topic3.Title: Affordable Commercial Pilot Program
Topic3.Summary: Staff and CU Real Estate Center graduate students presented research on rising commercial lease costs in Boulder and proposed developing an affordable commercial pilot program. The model would involve a master lease subdivided into micro-spaces for small businesses and nonprofits, with shared education and training resources. Staff proposed an RFP for a community partner and community engagement in 2023 and 2024, using ARPA and Central Area General Improvement District funds. Council supported exploring the program while raising questions about cost, sustainability, and selection criteria.
